title: StackKit Advanced trust bundle v1
description: Input of `stackkit advanced trust import --bundle`: the public Ed25519 issuer keys that may sign stackkit.advanced-capability/v1 documents. The file must be the exact canonical JSON form (no whitespace, fixed key order, at most 65536 bytes); its sha256 is pinned with --expect-sha256. internal/advancedtrust is the authority.

keyId.description: ed25519://sha256/<hex> of the raw public key bytes.

publicKey.description: Unpadded standard Base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key.
